components.purpose: Core of the page — dynamically renders the full single blog article (title, author, image, body) when bound to an item in the Posts dynamic page list. This is the component Agility built specifically for a blog post details template, so it anchors the top/main area of the page.
Placed below the article body as a marketer-oriented engagement component, giving readers who just finished the post a clear next step to subscribe — a standard pattern for blog article templates.
